author: Joseph Sardin
note: Attribution is not required. Recorded because this project keeps a source list for third-party material. Edited files are the wavs in this folder. Original downloads were not copied into the game.

sources.description: Manual roller shutter closing, one hand, indoor.
sources.edit: Densest 1.05 seconds, short fade, two lowpassed reflections at 29 ms and 53 ms.

sources.description: Underground parking in Chartres, stereo soundscape with occasional tire noise.
sources.edit: Steadiest 18-second region, highpass 50 Hz, lowpass 4200 Hz, 0.45-second loop crossfade.

sources.description: Iveco Daily 3.0 40C14 HPI diesel, recorded outdoors.
sources.edit: Steadiest 3.2 seconds, highpass 70 Hz, lowpass 3400 Hz so it sits inside concrete, 80 ms loop crossfade.

sources.description: Kia Carnival sliding side door opening, recorded inside the vehicle.
sources.edit: First 0.92 seconds from the opening onset, one short reflection.

sources.description: Two sheet-steel bars falling onto a path.
sources.edit: Loudest hit, pitched-down body, highpassed metal, plus an original 46/71 Hz and lowpassed-noise mass tail. That tail is not from the recording; no CC0 van-into-concrete collision was found.

sources.description: Squeal of four car tires locking up, recorded outdoors.
